author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260512T045359Z-1929490
text: Re-applying 'human' label pending resolution of JMAP-dibr (the meta-policy question 'should /do-beads delegate review-shaped epics or skip them'). Without this label, /do-beads picks this epic up on every iteration and either (a) burns tokens re-running an already-converged bd-review-loop or (b) deadlocks on a nested permission prompt as the 2026-05-11T17:08Z run did. The /do-beads command spec §1 explicitly warns: 'A human label marks a durable question for the human — those beads are not actionable autonomously and must be skipped, otherwise the loop will pick the same question-bead every session and never make progress.' Mark previously de-labeled with the note 'this should not be picked up by autonomous /do-beads — it filters epics from ready anyway'; reality is that /do-beads does NOT filter epics, only human-labeled beads. JMAP-dibr captures the resolution options. This re-label is a stopgap until JMAP-dibr is resolved.
